root_cause.text: The functions `vidtv_ts_null_write_into()` and `vidtv_ts_pcr_write_into()` take their argument structs by value, causing the compiler to copy the entire struct onto the stack; this stack copy includes uninitialized padding or fields (as detected by MSAN), leading to false-positive uninit-value warnings.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the function signatures from passing structs by value to passing const pointers, and the commit message explicitly states: "vidtv_ts_null_write_into() and vidtv_ts_pcr_write_into() take their argument structs by value, causing MSAN to report uninit-value warnings... Fix by passing both structs by const pointer instead, avoiding the stack copy of the struct along with its MSAN shadow and origin metadata."
